title: EquityTick
description: Phase 2 (watchlist-trigger): a single real-time observation of an underlying equity's last trade. Streamed from market-data-svc and signalled into WatchlistTriggerWorkflow (signal_name, default equityTick). retrieved_at is the wire-time stamp from the source feed. stale is set when the source flagged the print halted/old; a consumer MUST NOT drive a level trigger off a stale tick.

ticker.description: Underlying equity symbol the tick is for.

last.description: Last trade price of the underlying, dollars. Source-of-truth field for the level-trigger comparison.

retrieved_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the tick was observed by the source feed.

stale.description: True when the source flagged the print as halted/stale. Stale ticks are never emitted by SubscribeEquityActivity, so consumers should normally see false; the field exists so a future emit-on-stale policy stays explicit.
